Original tiny test fonts for FontFace resource replacement. Each contains only space, A, M and g. The before/replacement pair keeps identical advances, ascent, descent and M/g outlines while changing A from a triangle to a filled rectangle. The changed-metrics control has advance 900 instead of 600 units per em. All use 1000 units per em, ascent 800 and descent -200. No third-party outlines or font data are embedded. Generated with FontTools 4.66.1 FontBuilder and TTGlyphPen, WOFF2/Brotli compression.
